context: This criteria evaluates correct usage of the getSiteInfo server-side operation from @vercel/commerce-commercejs to fetch product categories and site metadata. It assesses proper operation invocation, correct category normalization, and accurate handling of the brands field which is intentionally empty in this provider.

checklist.name: getSiteInfo operation
checklist.description: The getSiteInfo operation is imported from @vercel/commerce-commercejs and called server-side

checklist.name: Normalized categories
checklist.description: Each category in the returned array has id, name, slug, and path fields derived from Commerce.js category data via normalizeCategory

checklist.name: Empty brands array
checklist.description: The brands field in the returned data is an empty array, as Commerce.js does not expose a brands API in this provider

checklist.name: Props structure
checklist.description: The function returns an object with a props key containing both categories and brands fields
